name: Ten Directions Zen Community
reason: Too thin: its own site (tendirectionszen.org, Squarespace; robots.txt puts Claude agents in the * group, so allowed) offers one weekly sitting in a rented room at the Theosophical Society in Wheaton, a Thursday Zoom sitting and an old blog (posts 2015-2018); its last retreat (Oct 2026) has passed and none is scheduled, no YouTube channel of its own (it links a YouTube search), no premises of its own. Email director@tendirectionszen.org was published. Guiding teacher Zen Master Jok Um (not on Spiritpedia).
